usecase.name: [QA Validation App] UJ-14 Application Secret in Secret Step
usecase.description: Add a secret on the application's Secrets page (value never shown), see it inherited with an Application badge and without a Delete action on a new use case, pick it as 'key (application)' in a secret step, then delete the use case and the application secret

steps.instruction: Focus the username field
Focus the password field
Click the 'Sign in' button
Click the 'Applications' menu item in the left navigation
Open the application 'QA Studio' (click its card if several applications are listed)
Is the application 'QA Studio' detail page shown?
Open the 'Actions' dropdown in the application page header
Select 'Secrets' under 'Configuration' in the dropdown
Is the page heading 'Secrets' shown?
Is the breadcrumb 'Applications > QA Studio > Secrets' shown?
Click the 'Add new secret' button
Type '{{secret_key}}' in the Secret Key field
Type 'qa-hidden-app-value' in the Secret Value field
Click the 'Save Secrets' button
Is the message 'Secrets saved successfully' shown?
Is '{{secret_key}}' listed in the Current Secrets table?
Is the text 'qa-hidden-app-value' visible anywhere on the page?
Click the 'Use cases' menu item in the left navigation
Click the 'Create Use case' button
Select the 'Create New' option
Click the 'Next' button
Select the 'Web' platform option
Click the 'Next' button
Type '{{usecase_name}}' in the Name field
Type 'https://example.com' in the Starting URL field
Select 'eu-central-1' in the Execution Region dropdown
Select 'nova-act-v1.0' in the Model dropdown
Select 'QA Studio' in the Application dropdown
Click the 'Next' button
Select the 'Create Blank' option
Click the 'Next' button
Click the 'Next' button
Click the 'Create' button
Click the 'Secrets' tab
Is '{{secret_key}}' listed in the Current Secrets table with an 'Application' badge?
Does the row '{{secret_key}}' in the Current Secrets table have a 'Delete' button?
Click the 'Workflow Steps' tab
Click the 'Add Step' button
Type 'Secret' in the 'Search step types...' field
Select the 'Secret' option
Type 'Click into the password field.' in the Instruction field
Open the 'Select Secret' dropdown
Is the option '{{secret_key}} (application)' listed in the 'Select Secret' dropdown?
Select the option '{{secret_key}} (application)'
Click the 'Create Step' button
Does the Workflow Steps list show a step with the 'Secret' badge?
Does the Secret step show the secret key '{{secret_key}}'?
Click the 'Use cases' menu item in the left navigation
Type '[QA Test] AppSecret {{UniqueID}}' in the search bar
Click the checkbox in front of use case '{{usecase_name}}'
Open the actions dropdown above the table
Select 'Delete Selected (1)' from the dropdown
Type 'permanently delete' in the confirmation field of the dialog
Click the 'Delete' button in the dialog
Is use case '{{usecase_name}}' listed in the table?
Click the 'Applications' menu item in the left navigation
Open the application 'QA Studio' (click its card if several applications are listed)
Is the application 'QA Studio' detail page shown?
Open the 'Actions' dropdown in the application page header
Select 'Secrets' under 'Configuration' in the dropdown
Is the page heading 'Secrets' shown?
Is the breadcrumb 'Applications > QA Studio > Secrets' shown?
Click the 'Delete' button in the row '{{secret_key}}' of the Current Secrets table
Is the message 'Secret "{{secret_key}}" deleted successfully' shown?
Is '{{secret_key}}' listed in the Current Secrets table?
